bio.text: Trever Nehls, a former Fort Bend County Precinct 4 constable, won the Republican nomination for Texas's 22nd Congressional District in the March 2026 primary, according to ABC13 Houston and the Associated Press.
He served two terms as constable, from 2013 to 2020, and was an unsuccessful candidate for Fort Bend County sheriff in 2020 and for Fort Bend County judge in 2022.
He is the identical twin brother of U.S. Rep. Troy Nehls, the district's incumbent, who announced on November 29, 2025 that he would not seek re-election.
